intro_line: Changsha: spicy food, ancient academies and riverside nights.
intro: Changsha rewards visitors with fiery Hunan food, a lively riverfront and deep history at Yuelu Academy. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: Metro has 5 lines plus a maglev link to the airport; fares are low, roughly ¥2-8.
Buses cost ¥1-2; air-conditioned and cross-city routes cost ¥2.
Taxis start at ¥8 by day and ¥10 at night; meters are standard.
Ride apps like DiDi work well; have the destination in Chinese.
Driving is busy and parking is hard; metro is easier for visitors.
Walking is fine downtown; shared bikes suit short riverside hops.

airports.name: Changsha Huanghua International Airport
airports.note: Main airport, about 24 km east of the centre.

options.note: Runs 06:00-22:00; also shuttles to South Railway Station.

options.to: Changsha South Railway Station, then city centre
options.note: Fastest rail option; transfer to Metro Line 2.
Taxis wait outside arrivals; use the meter.
Book in the app; meet at the designated pickup zone.
